economic_rationale: Ulcer Index measures the depth and persistence of completed-day downside paths rather than symmetric volatility or another directional oscillator. The mechanism is useful only if switching between 100 and 50 percent BTC on a lagged self-relative boundary preserves at least 70 percent of buy-and-hold upside after costs while materially reducing drawdown and improving Calmar with annual and 21/35-day neighbor breadth.
mechanism: For each complete UTC day, compute the square root of the mean squared percentage drawdowns from the running maximum inside the trailing 28 completed-day close window. Compare the current value with the median of the prior 252 available Ulcer values, excluding the current day. Hold 100 percent BTC when current Ulcer is at or below that lagged median and 50 percent BTC plus 50 percent zero-yield cash when above it. Execute only a changed regime target at the next H1 open. Rejection-only neighbors use 21 and 35 completed days.
thesis: A causal daily Ulcer28 regime overlay can retain a permanent half-size BTC core while reducing the other half during unusually deep and persistent downside paths, improving after-cost risk-adjusted performance over full-capital buy-and-hold without relying on a full-cash timing state.
title: Daily Ulcer28 passive-core 100/50-percent BTC risk overlay
